data.one_liner: Mockups and frames for common devices to preview and test Flutter apps.
data.what_it_does: Provides simulated device frames (phones, tablets, laptops, desktop monitors) to wrap widgets inside. Includes support for custom device creation, simulated virtual keyboards, and matching device media queries.
use_when: You want to preview your app UI within simulated device frames.
You need to test how your layout behaves on different screen sizes and platforms.
You want to render a simulated virtual keyboard inside your test frames.
avoid_when: You need a full interactive device preview environment with state inspection tools like DevicePreview.
You are building a production user interface that requires real hardware controls.
strengths: Supports a wide variety of preset devices across iOS, Android, Windows, macOS, and Linux.
Allows custom generic device creation using factories like DeviceInfo.genericPhone.
Includes a simulated virtual keyboard widget.
weaknesses: Limited to visual device frames and basic simulated UI wrappers rather than complete system emulation.
Does not include advanced built-in localization or multi-device scale controls compared to larger preview tools.
data.setup_notes: Simply wrap any widget in a DeviceFrame and pass a device model.
data.minimal_example:
DeviceFrame(
    device: Devices.ios.iPhone11,
    isFrameVisible: true,
    orientation: Orientation.portrait,
    screen: Container(
        color: Colors.blue,
        child: Text('Hello'),
    ),
)
